{"relevant": true, "severity": "warn", "message": "web/src/auth.ts storing the JWT in localStorage exposes it to any XSS (one injected script can exfiltrate the token and hijack the session). Fix: set it in an HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict (or Lax) cookie from internal/auth/login.go instead of returning it in the body, and add CSRF protection if using cookies. Also verify in login.go: password compared with bcrypt/argon2 (constant-time), signing secret loaded from env/secret store (not hardcoded), a short `exp`, explicit signing-algorithm pinning on verify (reject `none`/alg confusion), and rate limiting/lockout on /login to block credential stuffing. Return the same generic error for unknown user and wrong password to avoid user enumeration."}
